approved_decisions.3C-1: Check the official website for every retained Farrier and Horse Owner when an official site exists.
approved_decisions.3C-2: Run harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search only after an official-site role or contact gap.
approved_decisions.3C-3: Start with name, current title, current company, location and profile URL, then review a bounded output before expanding the allowlist.
approved_decisions.3C-4: Use the Actor's independent email-search capability as a separately governed provider action for professional email; do not label the email as LinkedIn-sourced.
approved_decisions.3C-5: Allow search-engine discovery only to locate an official website; search snippets are not evidence.
approved_decisions.3C-6: Do not add any direct A2 registry or association beyond evidence already collected by A1.
approved_decisions.3C-7: Keep Apollo, Clay and other enrichment providers unselected and unconnected pending Equinet tests.
approved_decisions.3C-8: Keep Apify runtime blocked until rights, vendor, account, build, budget, retention and connector gates pass.
